svg.title: Cecil counts seven property plaques but no utility premises for Municipal Hall.
svg.desc: Seven blank property plaques climb a wall crossed by pipes and cables. Beside them, a clean compositing pane is reserved to show active meter demand but no current Hall premises in the utility register. Cecil indexes the contradiction while Riju offers to join the numbers.
svg.text: Page 6, panel 2 · Low vertical shot up a corner crowded with blank property plaques

text.tspan: Cecil discovers seven property identities attached
to the compound, yet no Municipal Hall service

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
